title: No matching pair
prompt: The original problem guarantees a matching pair. What should your function do when no pair exists?
requirement: Return an empty list when no two distinct indices add up to the target. Keep returning a valid pair when one exists.
details: A valid pair may not exist. Return [] when no pair exists.
Do not use the same element twice. When a pair exists, return its indices in any order.
constraints: There is at most one valid pair. Return [] if there is none.

title: Ignore surrounding text
prompt: Now the input can contain ordinary text as well as brackets. Can you validate the brackets without treating the text as an error?
requirement: Ignore every non-bracket character. Validate only (), [] and {} in their original order.
details: The input may contain ordinary text. Ignore all characters except ()[]{}.
Bracket types and nesting must still match. Text with no brackets is valid.
constraints: s may contain text and bracket characters.
description: Given a string s that may contain text and brackets, determine whether its bracket characters are correctly matched and nested.

title: An empty collection
prompt: A caller can now pass an empty collection. What result makes sense, and will your implementation handle it?
requirement: Accept an empty nums array and return false. Preserve duplicate detection for nonempty inputs.
details: The array may be empty. An empty array contains no duplicate, so return false.

title: Missing price history
prompt: The price feed may return no observations. How should the profit calculation behave when there is no trading history?
requirement: Accept an empty prices array and return 0. Keep all existing rules for buying before selling.
details: The price feed may be empty. Return 0 when no transaction is possible.
You must buy before you sell.

title: No observations yet
prompt: The caller may have no values yet. Return zero for that case, while still choosing a nonempty subarray when values exist. What changes?
requirement: Return 0 only for an empty nums array. For nonempty input, the selected subarray must remain nonempty, including all-negative arrays.
details: If nums is nonempty, choose a nonempty contiguous subarray. All-negative inputs must return their largest value.
